entities.summary: Pavol Habera (b. 1962-04-12, Brezno) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Brezno and Slovakia. Known in the fields of slovakia, composers & musicians, europe.
